Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::queryLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): LoanTerm {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemId),
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestId)
	precondition:
		term.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newTerm: LoanTerm in
		newTerm.oclIsNew() and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newTerm)
}
